verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robot simulator, and its first-party materials cover every part of the story: multiple pluggable physics engines (ODE, Bullet, DART) through Gazebo Physics, and sensor simulation with optional noise for lidar, 2D/3D cameras, depth, contact, force-torque, IMU, GPS and more. It also offers prebuilt robots (PR2, TurtleBot, etc.) with physically accurate environment models from Gazebo Fuel and realistic OGRE v2 rendering. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of physics and sensor fidelity, since all evidence is vendor docs and README claims.
